citation.title: Fast topology optimization of phononic crystal‐based metastructures for vibration isolation by deep learning
citation.authors: Chen-Xu Liu, Gui-Lan Yu, Zhanli Liu
citation.venue: Computer-Aided Civil and Infrastructure Engineering 39(5) (2024) 776-790 (Crossref; published online 2023-09-30 per the pool record; hybrid open access, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 per Crossref and OpenAlex). The DOI now resolves to Elsevier (pii S1093968726016749)
citation.version_coded: none: only the abstract was read (pool record from OpenAlex). The version of record could not be retrieved

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no accessible full text). Abstract only: the deep-learning-based optimization (DLBO) reaches bandgap results similar to or better than a genetic algorithm while needing 0.01% of the GA's time.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not coded. Would-be value from the abstract: 0.01% of the GA time corresponds to a factor of 10,000 [derived: 1 ÷ 0.0001]; the GA and DLBO times themselves are not in the abstract.
claim.alternatives: Abstract: DLBO learns a map from metastructure features to bandgaps and needs no pre-optimized data; metastructures with other periodic constants and filling fractions are optimized; a design for subway-induced vibration is checked with a 3D finite element model.

notes: Access attempts on 2026-09-24, all with a generic User-Agent and no personal data: (1) doi.org now redirects to linkinghub.elsevier.com (pii S1093968726016749); the ScienceDirect article page returned HTTP 403 with a captcha page by curl, and HTTP 403 via WebFetch. (2) The Wiley full-text page (onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/mice.13100): HTTP 403 via WebFetch. (3) OpenAlex lists only the publisher DOI (any_repository_has_fulltext false). (4) arXiv API searches by title words and authors gave no preprint. (5) The abstract says the datasets and code are shared; two GitHub repository searches found nothing, and the article's link could not be read. No challenge or captcha was attempted. The article is open access (CC BY-NC-ND), so a human verifier can read it in a browser. Pointers from the abstract for the verifier: (a) §5.1 rule 1 would select the abstract's quantitative comparison (similar or better bandgaps than a GA in 0.01% of its time), i.e., the speed stratum with a would-be factor of 10⁴; the comparator is a genetic algorithm, a classical non-learned optimizer. (b) Domain check first: the physics is elastic-wave bandgaps of phononic crystals, and §4 excludes acoustic TO, so FT-DOMAIN is possible; the screener treated elastic-wave physics as in scope. The same judgment affects P00549 and P00893 (same research area; P00893 shares the author Gui-Lan Yu). Screening code was I-SPEED. No author named Jun Wang.
